content.title_original: EBMG registration for Genetic Counsellors and Genetic Nurses
content.description_original: This is a registration route rather than a course. The current public list of assessed Master’s programmes is counselling-focused; no dedicated, currently assessed pan-European MSc in genetic nursing was identified on the EBMG list.
